a.xlink:title: TEST INPUT. 100 CRONOS3 ids sampled by country (at least one per country, rest proportional) with their real interview date and a random coordinate inside the country's bounding box. The coordinates are synthetic stand-ins for the D7.1 geo-imputed points and must not be read as respondent locations. Postcodes are not carried over.

a.xlink:title: python make_test_locations.py (defaults: -n 100 --seed 20260921). Keeps respondents with an interview date in the 11 SoGreen countries, draws a country-stratified sample, assigns a uniform random point inside a land-heavy country bounding box and takes the interview date from w6inwds. Output coordinates are synthetic.

Download the 8 daily weather variables of D7.3 Table 2 (ERA5-Seamless) at every location from 2024-01-01, optionally the 1991–2020 baseline (planned). One Parquet file per location plus a provenance JSON per run; resumable. Test run on the free tier with --sleep 2; the ~10k production run needs --apikey.

a.xlink:title: python download_weather_baseline.py --locations <file> --apikey $OPENMETEO_KEY. Same variables and model as the daily weather, fixed 1991-01-01 to 2020-12-31, 5 points per request (~800–900 call units per location, so commercial key only). Not run in the test; produces the planned 1991–2020 baseline dataset. Script: https://gitlab.sikt.no/nsd-no/dataforvaltning/dataprosessering/faggruppe/sogreen-open-meteo/-/blob/6f3b4ce71575c68898d4e23fb52266af5171c698/download_weather_baseline.py

python download_weather.py --locations files/test_locations_100.csv --output-dir output_test --sleep 2. models=era5_seamless, daily, 2024-01-01 to today−7 days (ERA5 lag; here 2026-09-14), wind_speed_unit=ms, timezone=auto, 20 points per request. 100 written, 0 failed. Long runtime due to free-tier rate-limit pauses. Script: https://gitlab.sikt.no/nsd-no/dataforvaltning/dataprosessering/faggruppe/sogreen-open-meteo/-/blob/6f3b4ce71575c68898d4e23fb52266af5171c698/download_weather.py

g.title: n15

a.xlink:title: TEST OUTPUT. One Parquet file per location (100 files, ~47 KB each), daily values in local calendar days from 2024-01-01 to 2026-09-14 (988 days) from the Open-Meteo Historical Weather API, model era5_seamless (ERA5-Land 0.1° for temperature, ERA5 0.25° for wind), wind in m/s. Run record: output_test/weather_run_20260921T200756Z.json. Estimated ~0.5 GB for the ~10k production locations. The SoGreen air-quality workflow, rendered from the DDI-CDI model sogreen-air-quality-100-locations-BB.jsonld and rooted on this dataset.
